description: A cluster's objects as Freelens lists them, read through the host's kubeconfig and kubectl: its contexts (contexts), whether a context is still there as the head knows it (check: answered removed, or with nothing else; kubectl isn't run), one connected to (connect), a kind's objects (list), an object's YAML (yaml), what controls an object (owner), a pod deleted (delete), objects applied from YAML (apply), a pod's log as it is now (logs), a command run in a pod's container (exec: no terminal, its output when it ends), the whole stack's CPU and memory (summary, a read as list is). Secrets' values are never read.

req.description: The request's number, the client's pick: its answers carry it back.

server.description: The context's server as the head knows it (KubeContext's): a context of that name with another server is another cluster, and the request is answered removed.

page.description: list, yaml: the kind's page, by its resource.

crd.description: list, yaml: a custom resource's definition (plural.group) for a kind that isn't listed.

selector.description: list: only the objects whose labels match this selector (kubectl's -l: app=web,tier!=cache); a Secret's or a Helm release's page lists every one.

namespaces.description: summary: the namespaces it's the totals of (every one when it's left out; none when it's empty).

since.description: summary: the newest history sample the head has (its at): only later ones are sent (every one when it's left out).

fresh.description: summary: read the cluster now (Refresh), not a read the host kept or the fault it holds while it waits to try a failing cluster again.

namespace.description: yaml, owner, delete, logs, exec: the object's namespace; apply: where objects that name none go.

name.description: yaml, owner, delete, logs, exec: the object's name (logs, exec: the pod's).

force.description: delete: at once, not waiting for the pod to stop.

manifest.description: apply: the objects, as YAML or JSON (kubectl apply -f -).

container.description: logs, exec: the container (the pod's default if none).

tail.description: logs: its last this many lines (the Kubernetes view's number if none).

command.description: exec: what's run, its argv (kubectl exec --, with no terminal and nothing on its stdin).

timeout.description: exec: seconds it may run (60 if none; 600 at most): then it's stopped.
